native_result.query: How does the consideration of academic characteristics alter the effects of Socioeconomic Status and race on BA degree completion?
native_result.HypoA: When academic characteristics are considered, the effect of SES on BA degree completion is reduced and the effect of race is enlarged.
native_result.HypoB: Adding academic characteristics to a race-and-SES base model substantially attenuates the parental-education SES gradient on BA-completion proxy (~46–62% reduction, robust across listwise and MICE), but does NOT significantly attenuate the Black–NBNH gap (Δcoef NS in both), while the Hispanic–NBNH contrast actually grows more positive once academics are controlled; race × ASVAB and SES × ASVAB interactions are not significant at the 5% level; BA completion itself is unobserved in nls_raw.csv, so the outcome is the dorm_sustained_81_84 proxy.
native_result.WorkflowB: 1. Loaded data/nls_raw.csv (12,686 rows × 61 columns). 2. Constructed headline outcome dorm_sustained_81_84 = 1 if residence code 3.0 (DORM/FRATERNITY/SORORITY) observed in ≥2 of waves 1981–1984 (and ≥2 of those four waves observed); N_observed=8,548, prevalence=6.8% (Black 2.1%, Hispanic 7.8%, NBNH 7.5%). Constructed companion dorm_ever_81_86 for one-time robustness check. 3. Constructed SES blocks: parents_edu = mean(mother_1979, father_1979) with single_parent_missing dummy; log_income_79 = log1p(total net family income 1979, pre-treatment); log_wealth_85 reserved for sensitivity only (concurrent with college; partly endogenous). 4. Constructed academic block: asvab_composite = per-person mean of the four 1981 ASVAB standardized z-scores (AR/WK/PC/MK) with grand-mean fallback; class_rank_pct = rank/size where rank≤size. 5. Listwise-analytic N=2,910; full imputed base N=8,548. 6. Logistic regression (logit link, HC1 SE) — coefficients and Δcoef(A→B) reported on log-odds scale; Δcoef SE computed via Var(β̂_A)+Var(β̂_B) since the two logit fits are independent. 7. Models: A (race + SES + demographics); B (A + asvab_composite + class_rank_pct); C (B + race×ASVAB + SES×ASVAB). AMEs at ASVAB quartiles by race computed from C. 8. MICE with m=20, cycles=10, PMM continuous / logistic categorical, incarceration variables (ever_sentenced_pre1980, ever_jailed_through_1996) only inside the imputation model as auxiliary, then pooled by Rubin's rules on the within-imputation deltas. 9. Sensitivity D (n=2,273): adds log_wealth_85 + log_wealth_85×ASVAB — headline pattern preserved. 10. Companion outcome check: dorm_ever_81_86 produces is_black Δcoef = −2.22 (p=0.024), confirming the headline's proxy-dependence. 11. Cross-check: listwise and MICE agree on sign and significance of all headline Δcoef so the analysis stops here.
